name: Jonadab
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: He takes up Jehonadab the son of Rechab, whose heart is right with his, into the chariot to see his zeal for the Most High.

note.label: 2 Kings 10: Jehu Destroys Baal and Falls Short of the Law

points: The Most High tells Jeremiah to point Judah to the Rechabites: the sons of Jonadab kept their father's command to drink no wine to this day, but this people would not hearken to Him though He rose early and spoke.

note.label: Jeremiah 35: The Obedience of the Rechabites

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org

cases.name: Jonadab and the Rechabites
cases.charge: Obeying the voice of Jonadab their father in all that he charged them: drinking no wine, building no house, sowing no seed, planting no vineyard, but dwelling in tents all their days
